# Check Space

> Free disk space analyzer for Windows and Linux that shows you which files and folders are using the most storage on your PC.

Check Space is a free, open-source desktop application for Windows 10/11 and Linux x64. It scans your hard drive and displays a visual map of disk usage so you can quickly identify large files, forgotten downloads, application caches, and duplicate data to free up space. It also finds byte-identical duplicates (verified with SHA-1), suggests safe cleanups, exports CSV/JSON reports, updates itself from inside the app and is available in thirteen languages. On Windows it ships as an installer and a portable .exe; on Linux as a .deb for Debian/Ubuntu and a portable AppImage. No registration required, no data sent to any server, no telemetry. Licensed under MIT.

## Key Features
- Real-time disk analysis: scans and visualizes disk usage while it builds
- Visual folder map: interactive tree view sorted by file or folder size
- Large file finder: sort directories and files by size to locate heavy files quickly
- Verified duplicate finder: size, edge fingerprint and full SHA-1 confirmation
- Cleanup suggestions: temp caches, trash, browser caches, update leftovers and node_modules
- Deletion with explicit confirmation (trash or permanent), never automatic
- CSV and JSON export
- Portable versions: Windows .exe and Linux AppImage run without installation (ideal for machines without admin rights)
- External drive support: analyze USB drives, external disks, Linux mount points and any accessible folder
- Linux integration: native title bar, mount detection with lsblk/proc, and no crossing into other filesystems when scanning /
- 100% local: no accounts, no internet connection needed, no data leaves your computer
- Thirteen interface languages: Spanish, English, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Turkish, Korean, Dutch
- In-app updates: the Windows installer and the Linux AppImage check GitHub Releases, download the new version and install it on restart, without visiting the website; the Linux .deb updates through the package manager
- Lightweight Electron app: fast to open and scan, low resource usage

## Technical details
- Built with: Electron + React
- Current version: 1.2.0
- License: MIT (open source, auditable)
- Compatible with: Windows 10, Windows 11, Linux x64 (.deb for Debian/Ubuntu, AppImage)
- macOS version: in development, not available yet
- Interface languages: Spanish, English, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Turkish, Korean, Dutch
- Not affiliated with Microsoft, WinDirStat, TreeSize, or any other disk utility
